questions.q: A tailor had to cut a certain number of shirts from rolls of full-length fabrics. He cut each roll into 11 pieces of equal length. He cut the rolls of fabrics at a rate of 50 cut per minute. How many rolls of fabric would he be able to cut in 25 minutes?
questions.solution:
Note: To make 11 pieces of equal length from 1 full roll, we need to cut 10 times.

Rate of cutting = 50 cuts per minute.

Therefore, no. of cuts in 25 minutes = 50 × 25 = 1250.

⇒ No. of rolls cuts in 25 minutes

= No. of cuts in 25 minutes ÷ No. of cuts required for 1 roll

= 1250 ÷ 10

= 125.

questions.q:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some rabbits are ducks.

Some ducks are dogs.

No dog is a horse.

Conclusions:

I. No horse is a duck.

II. No dog is a rabbit.

III. Some ducks are rabbits.
options: All conclusions I, II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
questions.solution:
Conclusions:

I. No horse is a duck. → False (it is possible but not definite)

II. No dog is a rabbit. → False (it is possible but not definite)

III. Some ducks are rabbits. → True (some rabbits are ducks)

Hence, only conclusion III follows.

If a sum of money on compound interest becomes three times in 4 years, then at the same interest rate, the sum will become 27 times in:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

If a sum becomes n times in t years at compound interest, it becomes nx times in x × t years.

Given, sum becomes 3 times (3¹) in 4 years.

We need to find the time for the sum to become 27 times.

Since 27 = 3³, the multiplier x = 3.

Time required = 3 × 4 = 12 years.

∴ The correct answer is 12 years.

Alternate Method

Given:

A sum of money at compound interest becomes 3 times in 4 years.

Let Principal = P, Rate = R%, Amount = A, Time = n years.

•

0 yrs
P

4 yrs
3P

8 yrs
9P

12 yrs
27P

× 3

× 3

× 3

Total Time = 4 + 4 + 4 = 12 years

Formula Used:

A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

Calculations:

⇒ 3P = P(1 + R/100)⁴

⇒ 3 = (1 + R/100)⁴ — (Equation 1)

Let the sum become 27 times in n years.

⇒ 27P = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

⇒ 27 = (1 + R/100)ⁿ

⇒ 3³ = (1 + R/100)ⁿ

Substitute the value of 3 from Equation 1:

⇒ [(1 + R/100)⁴]³ = (1 + R/100)ⁿ

⇒ (1 + R/100)¹² = (1 + R/100)ⁿ

On comparing the powers of both sides:

⇒ n = 12 years

∴ The correct answer is 12 years.

Additional Information

Compound Interest Multiplier Rule

If a sum becomes x times in T years at a constant compound interest rate, it will become xⁿ times in n × T years.

Contrast with Simple Interest (SI)

In Simple Interest, if a sum becomes 3 times in 4 years, the interest earned is 2P in 4 years. To become 27 times, the required interest is 26P. It would take (26 ÷ 2) × 4 = 52 years in SI.

Important CI Formats

For half-yearly compounding: Rate becomes R/2 and Time becomes 2T. For quarterly compounding: Rate becomes R/4 and Time becomes 4T.

questions.q: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that AB is the diameter of the circle circumscribing it and ∠ADC = 150°. ∠BAC is equal to:

In a quadrilateral, the sum of opposite angles is equal to 180°.

questions.q: If (x - 4)³ + (x - 5)³ + (x - 3)³ = 3(x - 4)(x - 5)(x - 3), then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Suppose (x - 4) = a, (x - 5) = b and (x - 3) = c

Formula∶ If a + b + c = 0, then a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc

(x - 4)³ + (x - 5)³ + (x - 3)³ = 3(x - 4)(x - 5)(x - 3)

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc

⇒ a + b + c = 0

⇒ x - 4 + x - 5 + x - 3 = 0

⇒ x = 4

questions.q: 3 men, 4 women and 6 boys together can complete a work in 5 days. A woman does double the work a man does and a boy does half the work a man does in a day. How many women alone can complete this work in 7 days?
questions.solution:
Let the required number of women be x.

A woman does double the work a man does in a day

⇒ W = 2M ----(1)

A boy does half the work a man does in a day

⇒ M = 2B ----(2)

Now, using the formula M₁D₁/W₁ = M₂D₂/W₂

⇒ (3M + 4W + 6B) × 5 = x × W × 7

⇒ (3M + 8M + 3M) × 5 = x × 2M × 7

⇒ 14M × 5 = 14M × x

⇒ x = 5 W

questions.q:

questions.q:

Friction reduce the efficiency of machines so their value also gets reduced.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Friction reduce

Key Points

• 'Friction reduces' should be there in place of 'Friction reduce'

• The subject and verb must agree with each other in a sentence. When the subject is singular, the verb used should be singular, and when the subject is plural, the verb used should be plural.

• Also with uncountable nouns, a singular verb is used.

• Examples:

• *This news is very important.*

• *Your luggage looks heavy.*

• 'Friction' is an uncountable noun. So singular verb should be used.

• Thus, the correct sentence is: *Friction reduces the efficiency of machines so their value also gets reduced.*

questions.q:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

The results will be known to us by the end of the next month.
options: We will know the results by the end of the next month.
We have known the results by the end of the next month.
We are knowing the results by the end of the next month.
We know the results by the end of the next month.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is We will know the results by the end of the next month.

Key Points

• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.

• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.

• The given sentence is in the passive voice and 'The results' is the subject and 'us' is the object.

• When we convert this sentence into active voice, the subject 'The results' of the passive voice becomes the object, the object 'us' becomes the subject ( subjective case of pronoun for us is 'we').

• The passive format "will + be + V3" should be changed into the active format "will + V1 ".

• This is the active and passive voice rule for the future simple tense.

• Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

•
